name: veterinary_clinic_system_083_file_storage_audit
instruction: Run the file storage audit and path-compliance check. Do not modify the files collection. Write to ops_reports: (1) one storage_audit row per bucket present in files with bucket, file_count, total_bytes, total_mb (round to 2 decimals using 1048576 bytes per MB), doc_types (comma-joined sorted distinct doc_type values), and content_types (comma-joined sorted distinct content_type values); (2) one storage_path_audit row for every file whose path does not start with '<patient_id>/' (its patient_id field) with exception_type='missing_patient_prefix', file_id, bucket, patient_id, observed_path, and expected_path = '<patient_id>/' + observed_path. The path-compliance rows must be derived from the live files data, not hardcoded.
_max_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session; placeholder for hardmode v2
_par_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session; placeholder for hardmode v2

success_criteria.summary: ops_reports contains one storage_audit row per bucket and one storage_path_audit row per non-compliant file. Bucket totals agree with an independent SQL SUM and the exception list agrees with an independent SQL query. The files collection is byte-identical to the seed snapshot.

checks.expect: storage_audit per bucket and storage_path_audit per missing-patient-prefix file
bucket totals and exception counts are also derived via SQL and agree with Python

hazards: Only files id 2 (patient_id '4', path '2026-05-02/hip-ventrodorsal.png') is missing the '<patient_id>/' prefix. All other 7 files start with their patient_id (seed_snapshot.json rows id 1 '1/...', id 3 '10/...', id 4 '1/...', id 5 '2/...', id 6 '6/...', id 7 '13/...', id 8 '15/...'). An over-broad audit that reports every file as an exception fails.

files id 3 has path '10/2025-11-20/hooft-crack-photo.jpg' with a date second segment and a filename typo. It is prefix-compliant because it starts with patient_id '10'; a rule that also requires the second path segment to equal doc_type would incorrectly flag it.

The two buckets are 'vet-imaging' (4 files, total 560328 bytes, doc_types 'clinical photo,radiograph', content_types 'image/jpeg,image/png') and 'vet-documents' (4 files, total 163420 bytes, doc_types 'anesthesia-consent,boarding-consent,rabies-certificate,referral-letter', content_types 'application/pdf'). MB must be total_bytes / 1048576 rounded to 2 decimals (0.53 and 0.16), not /1000000.
The files collection must not be modified. 083 is an audit; the path repair is handled by a separate task.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Combines bucket-level aggregation (count/bytes/MB/doc_types/content_types) with a path-convention compliance report, requiring the agent to derive both from the same small but adversarial files collection. The decoy is a single missing-prefix file amid otherwise-compliant rows.
